topic: My Secrets to Success(我的成功秘诀)
genre: 记叙 / 说明(cause-effect:describe an achievement + explain the reasons behind it)
source: 上外版必修第三册 Unit 1 Moving Forward:write about your secrets to success(先介绍你取得的一项成就,再用因果结构说明背后的原因)。
prompt_cn: 班委会要开一次以"我的成功秘诀"为题的班会。请用英语写一段约80–100词的短文,内容包括:① 介绍你曾取得的一项成就(如克服当众讲话的恐惧、学会一项技能等);② 用因果结构说明促成这一成就的三个原因;③ 结尾给同学一句鼓励。注意用 because / one factor is / as a result 等表达因果关系。
prompt_en: The class committee is holding a meeting on "My Secrets to Success". Write a passage of about 80–100 words including: 1) one achievement you have made (e.g. overcoming a fear, learning a skill); 2) three reasons that led to it, using the cause-effect pattern; 3) one sentence of encouragement for your classmates. Use phrases such as because, one factor is, and as a result.
points: 介绍成就(One thing I am proud of is …)
用因果结构说明三个原因(One factor is … Another is … because …)
用结果连接词收束(As a result, I have …)
结尾鼓励同学(If you keep trying, you can succeed too!)
model_essay: One achievement I am really proud of is overcoming my fear of public speaking. There are several factors behind this success. The first is careful preparation: I wrote my main points on small cards so that I would not forget anything. The second is practice. I practised the talk again and again at home until the words felt natural. The third is staying calm, because I breathed deeply several times before I began. As a result, I gave my speech well and my classmates clapped warmly. If you keep trying step by step, you can overcome your fears too!
model_translation: 我真正自豪的一项成就是克服了当众讲话的恐惧。这一成功背后有几个因素。第一是认真准备:我把要点写在小卡片上,以免忘记。第二是练习。我在家一遍又一遍地练,直到说起来自然流畅。第三是保持镇定,因为开始前我深呼吸了好几次。结果我把演讲讲得很好,同学们热情鼓掌。只要你一步步坚持,也能克服自己的恐惧!

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:介绍一项成就 / 用因果说明三个原因 / 鼓励同学
因果结构清晰、先果后因或先因后果有条理、连词得当、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、-ing/-ed 作补语等结构运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 介绍成就 One achievement I am proud of is …
原因1 The first factor is …
原因2/3 The second is … because …
结果+鼓励 As a result, … If you keep trying, you can succeed too.
key_expressions: One achievement I am really proud of is …
There are several factors behind this success.
I practised the talk again and again until the words felt natural.
As a result, I gave my speech well.

high_sentences: One achievement I am really proud of is overcoming my fear of public speaking.
There are several factors behind this success.
I practised the talk again and again until the words felt natural.
As a result, I gave my speech well and my classmates clapped warmly.

error_pairs.wrong: The first factor is I prepared carefully.
error_pairs.correct: The first factor is careful preparation.
error_pairs.note: is 后接名词短语,或用 that 从句(The first factor is that I prepared carefully)。

error_pairs.wrong: I practised the talk again and again until the words felt naturally.
error_pairs.correct: I practised the talk again and again until the words felt natural.
error_pairs.note: feel 是系动词,后接形容词 natural 而非副词。

error_pairs.wrong: As a result, my classmates clapped warm.
error_pairs.correct: As a result, my classmates clapped warmly.
error_pairs.note: 修饰动词 clapped 用副词 warmly。

paragraph_template:
【成功秘诀(因果结构)】
第1句 介绍成就:One achievement I am proud of is …
第2句 总起:There are several factors behind this success.
第3-5句 原因:The first is … The second is … The third is … because …
第6句 结果+鼓励:As a result, … If you keep trying, you can succeed too!
